summary: - **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the HepMC3 event position together with all vertices. Beam particles previously stayed at (0,0,0) while the rest of the event was smeared; they now start at the smeared interaction point.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws if shared actions are used in single-threaded mode. Previously this could silently write events twice through user output plugins. The DDSim `OutputConfig` example for multi-threaded user output plugins is corrected; steering files using custom output plugins (e.g. IDEA) need the corresponding kernel change.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg`, along with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Users must migrate to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag containing the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/113)** — GNNTrackFinding now uses native Gaudi list properties instead of comma-separated strings, and old string-style configurations are rejected at configuration time. The PR removes dead helpers and redundant edge deduplication.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`, using hit time as a CKF measurement dimension and an ACTS doublet seed-finding time cut. Per-sensor time resolutions are configured through `HitTimeResolutions` as a placeholder until EDM4hep stores per-hit time errors. The feature requires a recent ACTS version.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#41](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/41)** — Adds electromagnetic (`PhotonEMNonLinearity`) and hadronic (`HadronicThetaEnergyBinned`) energy correction plugins that use 2D (theta, energy) lookup tables. Corrections are applied inside Pandora so that cluster, PFO and jet energies stay consistent. Default behaviour is unchanged when no table is supplied.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — ConformalTracking gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID` and `ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties for extrapolation to the calorimeter face, with ILD/CLD defaults. This lets detectors such as ALLEGRO use the extrapolation. ECALs identified by type flags are now installed in KalTest, and track fits no longer fail when no calorimeter-face state is found.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes the `OverlayTiming` background cursor: `StartBackgroundEventIndex` was reapplied on every event, so the same background events were overlaid repeatedly. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` was never enforced. Jobs that relied on silent reuse of background events must now enable reuse explicitly.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes a bug in `TracksFromGenParticles` that occurred with `ExtrapolateToECal=False`. Uninitialized ECAL geometry was still read, so tracks could get calorimeter track states extrapolated with garbage geometry. A cellID truncation is also fixed.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/102)** — Fixes wrong collection association for wire hits in `GGTFTrackFinder` when there is more than one wire input collection. The finder no longer writes the track holding unclustered/noise hits, and only successfully reconstructed tracks are stored.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)** — `PairCaloClustersPi0` now solves the pi0 cluster-pairing problem as a graph maximum matching with Boost.Graph instead of an exponential exhaustive search. This makes the algorithm usable on hadronic events. Results match the previous algorithm apart from output ordering.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1689](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1689)** — The EDM4hep file reader now supports the new MDI synchrotron-radiation file format, which consists of parentless photons. For these photons, the vertex rather than the endpoint defines the Geant4 starting point.
